Three comments

The Weaving Lady

Beautiful slow reel written and played by Alan Doherty and friends on a YouTube video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C-1142GwUEQ. It’s played in A major on a Low F whistle but is easier transcribe down to G major. The piece is long because though it starts in a reel pattern it contains more improvised sections.

↳ Posted by Mikethebook on March 22nd, 2018.
